BANKBARODA: Dividend Visibility And Bond Plan Will Support Bullish Case
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Bank of Baroda from ₹320.09 to ₹311.35, citing updated assumptions on revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that modestly adjust the stock's assessed fair value. What's in the News Bank of Baroda has announced an annual dividend of ₹8.50 per share, payable on July 23, 2026, with an ex date and record date of June 5, 2026.

news.title: Upcoming dividend of ₹8.50 per share
news.body: Eligible shareholders must have bought the stock before 05 June 2026. Payment date: 23 July 2026. Payout ratio is a comfortable 22% but the company is not cash flow positive. Trailing yield: 3.2%. Within top quartile of Indian dividend payers (1.5%). Higher than average of industry peers (1.4%).

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹8.50
news.body: Dividend of ₹8.50 is 1.8% higher than last year. Ex-date: 5th June 2026 Payment date: 23rd July 2026 Dividend yield will be 3.2%, which is higher than the industry average of 1.1%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by earnings (22% payout ratio) and is expected to be well covered in 3 years' time (22% forecast payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 10% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 19% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹38.38 (vs ₹40.06 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹38.38 (down from ₹40.06 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹636.6b (down 1.1% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹198.5b (down 4.2% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 31% (down from 32% in FY 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 9.9% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.6% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 6% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 14% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Slight Valuation Tweaks Will Still Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target for Bank of Baroda slightly, from about ₹323 to about ₹320, reflecting small adjustments to fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E assumptions. Valuation Changes Fair Value: Trimmed slightly from about ₹323.24 to about ₹320.09 per share, indicating a small reduction in the estimated intrinsic value.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Planned Long Term Bond Issue Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their Bank of Baroda price target by about ₹9, reflecting slightly updated assumptions on fair value, discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E multiples, while keeping the overall investment case broadly intact. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has issued a strike notice for January 27, 2026, over various issues and demands.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Planned Long Term Bond Issue Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their 1 year price target for Bank of Baroda slightly to about ₹332 from roughly ₹333, reflecting small adjustments to long term fair value drivers such as the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and forward P/E assumptions. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has given notice of a proposed strike on January 27, 2026, over various issues and demands.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Bond Issue Plan Will Drive Bullish Long Term Outlook
news.body: Analysts have inched up their Bank of Baroda price target from about ₹331 to roughly ₹333, citing small refinements to fair value drivers such as discount rate and assumed future P/E, rather than any major shift in the underlying outlook. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has issued a strike notice for January 27, 2026, over various issues and demands affecting staff at Bank of Baroda branches and offices (Key Developments).

news.title: Now 20% overvalued after recent price rise
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has risen 12% to ₹324. The fair value is estimated to be ₹269, however this is not to be taken as a sell recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 10.0% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 11%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 9.1% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 7.1% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Bond Plans And Strike Risk Will Shape Steady Outlook
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for Bank of Baroda broadly unchanged at about ₹331 per share, reflecting largely stable assumptions around the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E multiples. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has served notice for a nationwide bank strike on January 27, 2026, and Bank of Baroda has flagged that branch and office operations could be affected even as it prepares contingency measures (company filing).

news.title: BANKBARODA: Bond Plan For Infrastructure And Housing Will Support Bullish Outlook
news.body: Analysts have nudged their price target for Bank of Baroda higher from ₹323.65 to ₹330.94, citing updated assumptions around expected revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E levels. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has given notice of a proposed strike on January 27, 2026, over various issues and demands, and the bank has indicated that while it is planning for smooth operations, branch and office functioning may still be affected if the strike goes ahead (Key Developments).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹10.53 (vs ₹10.08 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.53 (up from ₹10.08 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹167.9b (up 4.3% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹54.4b (up 4.4% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 32% (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 9.1% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 3.0% growth forecast for the Banks industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 11% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: BANKBARODA: Auditor Changes, Strike Risk And Bond Plan Will Shape Steady Outlook
news.body: Analysts have inched up their fair value estimate for Bank of Baroda to ₹323.65 from ₹321.74, citing small adjustments to discount rate assumptions, revenue growth expectations and future P/E inputs, while keeping profit margin forecasts broadly in line with prior views. What's in the News United Forum of Bank Unions has given notice of a proposed strike on January 27, 2026, over various issues and demands.
